narr: A slow-moving thunderstorm during the evening of May 13th produced between 2 and 3.5 inches of rain in western Muskingum County, resulting in flash flooding.
ev: Flooding was reported on State Route 60 between Zanesville and Dresden.
Near the Muskingum County Speedway, water was flowing over the road.
Flooding was reported on Fairview Road near the Green Valley Golf Course, with a culvert uplifted.
At the intersection of National Road and Timber Run Road, water was reported on the road, with a water rescue needed.
